invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Pair instance.
The left element, partitionPathStatMap, is never null at return.
The right element, globalStat, is instantiated and not null at return.
partitionPathStatMap will contain at most one entry per unique partition path in inputRecords, so the number of keys cannot exceed the number of input records.
If there are any input records, there will be inserts or updates counted in the globalStat.
